{{Quote|Remember Finis Valorum well, I do. Last of a great line, he was.|[[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]]|<ref name="Shatterpoint (novel)">[[Shatterpoint (novel)|''Shatterpoint'']]</ref>}}
'''House Valorum''' was an ancient and distinguished family who originated from the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]]. They had a long and distinguished political pedigree spanning thousands of years. By the time of the [[Battle of Naboo/Legends|Battle of Naboo]], they were one of the (if not the) longest-lasting political families of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Old Republic]], having been established for thirty generations. The Valorums were known for two things besides their family's age: their patronage of the arts and their affinity for following bureaucratic rules and procedures to the letter.

The Valorum family also owned [[Valorum Shipping and Transport]], a very profitable starship-production company on [[Eriadu/Legends|Eriadu]], and at the time of the Battle of Naboo, several of Finis Valorum's cousins lived on that planet, owning mansions larger than those owned by the planet's rulers. The Eriadu Valorums were rivals of the [[Tarkin family/Legends|Tarkin family]].<ref name="CoD">''[[Cloak of Deception]]''</ref>

At least four of its members served as [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] of the Old Republic, including [[Tarsus Valorum/Legends|Tarsus Valorum]] c. [[1000 BBY/Legends|1000 BBY]], [[Eixes Valorum]] and lastly, [[Finis Valorum/Legends|Finis Valorum]], as the last Chancellor before the rise of [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]]. Several decades before the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Invasion of Naboo]], Finis' father was chiefly responsible for granting the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] its free-trade status, a deal that increased the Valorum family's wealth and land holdings.
